name: ezpowers
description: Personal Codex workflow plugin: every EZPowers workflow and utility ships as an explicit skill.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven planning, reviews, and workflow skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: EZPowers exposes all workflows as Codex skills. Workflow skills (ezpowers:setup, ezpowers:design-architecture, ezpowers:spec, ezpowers:prepare-execute, ezpowers:choice-execute, ezpowers:review, ezpowers:sync-docs, ezpowers:eval, and more) are explicit-invocation only ($ezpowers:<name>); independent skills such as ezpowers:diagnose, ezpowers:frontend-design, and ezpowers:verifyself also match implicitly.
defaultPrompt: $ezpowers:setup Initialize the harness for this project.
